   • total_shares_purchased
   • avg_price_paid
   • shares_public_program
   • max_shares_remaining

   Retrieve daily closing prices that were recorded in the database for that month.

   Convenience helper that directly returns the avg_price_paid for each month in the supplied list.

   Given a list of numbers, return max(values) − min(values) rounded to two decimal places.

7. executive_compensation_for(name_substr: str) -> List[Tuple]
   Look up compensation information for executives whose names contain a given substring.

Question
Using the available information, determine the mathematical range (maximum minus minimum) of the average prices paid per share in October, November and December.  Return the result as a number with exactly two decimal places.
